rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Ambush Re-Deployment
rules.description: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.

rules.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
rules.description: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Counter
rules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

rules.name: Counter in Melee
rules.description: This model gets Counter on its weapons in melee.

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Destructive
rules.description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), those hits get AP(+1).

rules.name: Enhanced Nimble
rules.description: If this model has Nimble, it may move by up to 2D3" from Nimble (instead of only D3").

rules.name: Enhanced Rapid Blink
rules.description: If this model has Rapid Blink, it may move by up to 2D3" from Rapid Blink (instead of only D3").

rules.name: Enhanced Rapid Blink Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Rapid Blink. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +6" range on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Infiltrate
rules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

rules.name: Infiltrating Precision Strike
rules.description: Counts as having Infiltrate, and gets +1 to hit rolls in melee on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

rules.name: Nimble
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3".

rules.name: Rapid Blink
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3".

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Shielded
rules.description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

rules.name: Shielded Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shielded. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Slayer
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Takedown
rules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

rules.name: Takedown Shot
rules.description: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make X extra attacks against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

rules.name: Takedown Strike
rules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

rules.name: Teleport
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Teleport Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Teleport. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unpredictable
rules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

spells.name: Asphyxiating Fog
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Counter in Melee once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Blades of Discord
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 1 hit with AP(2) and Deadly(3).

spells.name: Fatal Sorrow
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 24" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits.

spells.name: Light Fragments
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Destructive.

spells.name: Shadow Dance
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Rapid Blink once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Veil of Madness
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Slayer against once (next time the effect would apply).
